in_hebrew.name: בִּרְגִינָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Virgina has its origins in the Hebrew language, where it is written as בִּרְגִינָה (Birgīnāh). The meaning of the name is 'maiden' or 'virgin'. In a broader sense, it can also mean 'young woman' or 'unmarried woman'. The long meaning of the name reflects its significance as a symbol of purity, innocence, and chastity.

in_greek.name: Παρθένος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Virgina in the Greek language is written as Παρθένος (Parthenos). The meaning of the name is 'virgin'. In ancient Greek culture, Parthenos was a title given to goddesses who were considered virginal or chaste. The long meaning of the name reflects its significance as a symbol of purity, innocence, and dedication to the divine.

in_latin.name: Virginea
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Virgina in the Latin language is written as Virginea. The meaning of the name is 'virgin'. The long meaning of the name reflects its significance as a symbol of purity, chastity, and modesty.
